semiconductor_relevance: High — izmo Microsystems specializes in System-in-Package (SiP) miniaturization and offers a wide range of packaging options for high-density, high-performance systems.
summary: izmo Microsystems Pvt. Ltd. is a semiconductor company based in Bangalore, India, focusing on advanced packaging solutions, particularly System-in-Package (SiP) technology. They provide custom packaging options to meet diverse design specifications and functional requirements, including complex mixed-technology assemblies.

regional_presence.India: The company operates facilities in Bangalore, focusing on advanced semiconductor packaging technologies.
